REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
C. File No. REG. 5968
SECTION D Station X
D. 20 / 32
Date August 25, 1932

Subject (in full) Miss N.M. Lanzova-Nevsorova, applicant for letter of character

Made by L.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the attached letter dated August 1
1932, Tokyo, from Miss N.M. Lanzova-Nevsorova to the Commissioner
of Police asking for a letter of character from the Shanghai Mu-
nicipal Police to the effect that she has no "police record", the
applicant's history and record as known to the Municipal Police
are as follows:-

Miss Nina Mihailovna Lanzova-Nevsorova, Russian, born
March 13, 1909 at Vladivostok. She is reported to have left Russia
for Harbin in either 1924 or 1925 and to have resided in that ci-
ty until October 1929 when she proceeded to Shanghai.

She is not registered with any of the Russian Emi-
grants organizations in Shanghai and only a few days ago a cer-
tain Mr S.F. Zaeff, of 1025/7 Bubbling Well Road, applied, on her
behalf, for registration with the Council of United Russian Pub-
lic Organizations at Shanghai, No 39 Avenue Edward VII.

Mr. Zaeff, who, among other things, is a solicitor who assists
people to obtain passports, visé's etc., acted as Miss Lanzova-
Nevsorova's guarantor in January, 1932, when she applied at the
local Japanese Consulate-General for a passport visé to enable
her to proceed to Japan. At that time she gave her address as
No 20 Tsongchow Road, her occupation as student and the object
of her trip to Japan as business ( private secretary to Mr.
George Street, American, of the Japan Wireless Telegraph Co, Jiji
Building, Tokyo). It is reported that she has been married re-
cently or is soon to be married to Mr. George Street, whom
met in Shanghai some time ago.

Miss Lanzova-Nevsorova holds Chinese passport
issued by the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau on January
1932.

D 分部 X 巡捕房

日期 1932年8月25日

事由（全称） N.M. Lanzova-Nevsorova 小姐，品行证明书申请人

制作人 L.S. Prokofiev 转呈人 （签名）

关于所附1932年8月1日发自东京、由 N.M. Lanzova-Nevsorova 小姐致警务处处长的信件，该信请求上海公共租界工部局警务处出具一份品行证明书，证明其无“警方案底”，现将工部局警务处所知的申请人履历及记录陈述如下：

Nina Mihailovna Lanzova-Nevsorova 小姐，俄国人，1909年3月13日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。据报她于1924年或1925年离开俄国前往哈尔滨，并在该市居住至1929年10月，随后前往上海。

她未在上海的任何俄罗斯侨民组织注册，就在几天前，住在静安寺路1025/7号的 S.F. Zaeff 先生代表她向位于爱多亚路39号的上海俄罗斯公共组织联合会理事会申请注册。

Zaeff 先生除其他事务外，还是一名协助人们办理护照、签证等的律师，他在1932年1月担任 Lanzova-Nevsorova 小姐的担保人，当时她向当地日本总领事馆申请护照签证，以便前往日本。那时她提供的地址是通州路20号，职业为学生，赴日目的为商务（担任东京日日大楼日本无线电信公司的美籍职员 George Street 先生的私人秘书）。据报她最近已结婚或即将与 George Street 先生结婚，她是不久前在上海结识该男子的。

Lanzova-Nevsorova 小姐持有上海市公安局于1932年1月签发的中国护照。

Tokyo, 16 Aug 1932

Shanghai Municipal Council
Police Dept.
Shanghai

Gentlemen:-

The writer requires a statement from
the Shanghai Police to the effect that
she has no "police record." This statement
is necessary in order to complete
certain papers for obtaining United States of
America passport from the American
Consulate, Tokyo.

I arrived in Shanghai in September or
October 1929 from Harbin and resided
in Shanghai until January 1932 since
when I have lived in Japan.

Your prompt attention will be greatly
appreciated. M.M. Lanzara-Westover

at above address; - c/o Mrs George Otwell

警务处
上海

诸位先生：

本人需要上海警方出具一份声明，证明本人无“警方案底”。此声明对于完成从美国驻东京领事馆获取美利坚合众国护照所需的某些文件是必要的。

我于1929年9月或10月从哈尔滨抵达上海，并在上海居住至1932年1月，此后一直居住在日本。

如蒙迅速关注，不胜感激。 M.M. Lanzara-Westover

通讯地址同上；- 转交 Mrs George Otwell
